total_model.summary: Model projects 42.2 total points (CAR 23, BAL 19). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 2.8), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.6), Natural grass field (lowers total 0.5). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
